note: The server's own manifest of region masks. Empty: no cavity, SDF, between-wrap or paired-surface artifact is registered for any real scroll, so none is offered. An entry binds physical_scroll, volume_id, grid, level, artifact_type, source_digest, content_sha256, merkle_root and chunk_count; produce one with `python -m argus.core.mask_registry`. Only the server reads this file; a caller never supplies a digest.
